execution_draft_not_frozen.position: spot long only; no leverage, shorting, funding or pyramiding
execution_draft_not_frozen.entry_signal_time: only fully closed bar; lag1 executes at next native5m open; lag2 at second following open
execution_draft_not_frozen.entry_and_signal_exit_price: signal bar close limit; improved fill at eligible open when marketable, else touch within eligible bar; fractional full fills assumed
execution_draft_not_frozen.time_in_force: GTC with explicit strategy timeout cancellation at the end of one eligible 5m bar; no carryover
execution_draft_not_frozen.buyhold: 95% of initial cash at first evaluation open, base fees and execution friction; no signals, ROI or stop
execution_draft_not_frozen.ROI_target: net1% including both fees and cash friction: entry_price*(1+fee+friction)*1.01/(1-fee-friction)
execution_draft_not_frozen.stop_trigger: entry_fill*0.75; gap below stop takes opening price
execution_draft_not_frozen.stop_order: market risk-exit substitution; this differs from reference default limit and precludes strict reproduction
execution_draft_not_frozen.intrabar_entry_policy: do not recognize same-bar ROI after intrabar limit entry; stop may still fire; open-filled entries permit stop then ROI
execution_draft_not_frozen.terminal: mark existing position at last close; no forced liquidation; estimated liquidation net value separate
execution_draft_not_frozen.friction_treatment: separate adverse cash cost, not a price fill outside the limit
execution_draft_not_frozen.MDD: all105408 native5m close equities plus initial cash; daily display sampling is not MDD input
execution_draft_not_frozen.Sharpe: UTC daily close returns, sqrt365, sample ddof1, rf0
